newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Explosion wounds three in Tirana centre.
newsitem.headline: Explosion wounds three in Tirana centre.

text.p: An explosion wounded three people and wrecked two cafes in the centre of the Albanian capital early on Tuesday, police said.

Explosives apparently planted at the site on the main Martyrs of the Nation Boulevard, close to the defence and interior ministries, badly damaged the structures and the gambling machines and video games inside.
Tirana is under a 10 p.m. to 5 a.m. curfew and the area was virtually deserted at the time.
Explosives and weapons were looted from arms depots during unrest early this year which followed the collapse of high-interest investment schemes.
Albanians are looking to the new government to be formed following June 29 elections to restore law and order.
